articles.title: FBI says Artex AI open source hacking tool used to breach networks in ‘under three hours’
articles.description: The FBI says that the open source hacking tool was used in cyberattacks targeting a U.S. IT giant and the South Korean financial industry.
articles.author: Zack Whittaker

articles.title: US tightens AI chip export controls to deter Chinese companies from accessing compute remotely
articles.description: Under the interim rule, the U.S. will require firms to get licenses to export AI chips if they may provide compute to China or other restricted countries.
articles.author: Ram Iyer

articles.title: Proton’s Lumo, a privacy-focused alternative to ChatGPT and Claude, arrives on desktop
articles.description: Proton's new Lumo Desktop app for Windows, Mac, and Linux lets users automate tasks across files and connected apps, with granular controls over what its AI can access.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: AI models can be tricked into identifying civilians as military targets by telling them it’s a game
articles.description: Vals, a San Francisco-based AI evaluation startup, tested whether leading AI models could be manipulated into participating in autonomous warfare. They usually compiled.
articles.author: Kirsten Korosec, Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: Jensen Huang says he would be ‘honored’ if allowed to return as Nvidia CEO
articles.description: In the first public statement since his resignation, Nvidia founder Jensen Huang signalled his willingness to return as CEO.
articles.author: Russell Brandom

articles.title: Daydream’s new AI agent acts as your personal stylist — and can shop for you, too
articles.description: Daydream's new AI shopping agent can remember your style, virtually try on clothes, plan outfits around your wardrobe, track sales, and complete purchases.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: Voyage Labs raises $12 million for a specialized AI travel assistant
articles.description: Voyage Labs’ flagship product is called Atlas, meant to work as a personal assistant for your trip-planning, available today in private beta.
articles.author: Russell Brandom

articles.title: Isomorphic Labs raises $5B as it looks to take drug candidates to clinical trials
articles.description: Isomorphic Labs, the AI drug-discovery platform that was spun out of Google’s DeepMind in 2021, has raised $5 billion in a Series C funding round.
articles.author: Ram Iyer

articles.title: Science Corporation’s brain tech is worth $3.5 billion after new funding
articles.description: Science Corp. raised a $400 million Series D to scale up its anti-blindness business.
articles.author: Tim Fernholz

articles.title: Nvidia’s first big move after Jensen Huang’s exit targets national security
articles.description: The new standing committee will give board-level oversight of national security policies, export control compliance, and global trade risks, the company said.
articles.author: Kirsten Korosec
